info.name: Trellix EDR Action History Devices API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of items to skip for pagination

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression to narrow device results by attributes such as name, operating system, or agent status.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order for results, specified as a field name with optional direction prefix (+ for ascending, - for descending).

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of all endpoint devices registered and managed through ePO SaaS. Returns device attributes including name, agent GUID, tags, operating system, and last communication timestamp.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: Unique identifier of the managed device

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific managed device by its unique identifier. Returns comprehensive device attributes including hardware details, installed products, and agent status.
